course.title: Operating Systems
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Say, you are tasked with designing an OS for a computer system, where many (15) [CO2] interactive processes may run concurrently, on a single core processor. Additionally, a process in this system may have many multiple concurrent worker threads in them. Decide and comment on the information you may choose to include in the process control block (PCB). Discuss about the strength and weakness of your PCB design choice in terms of system performance.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2024
